subject.title: Improve doctor/gateway diagnostics clarity for mixed LaunchAgent/runtime states

question: What final doctor diagnosis taxonomy and recovery-order output should OpenClaw standardize for mixed LaunchAgent, runtime, RPC, service-drift, and channel-conflict states?
rationale: Current main already collects most raw facts, but the user-facing final verdict, probable-cause ordering, and whether to add a JSON diagnosis block require maintainer UX direction.

options.title: Compose a final doctor verdict
options.body: Add a final healthy/degraded/down diagnosis with probable causes and ordered next steps after the existing panels run.

options.title: Keep independent panels
options.body: Leave doctor output as separate checks and only improve individual messages after a live transcript proves a specific confusing sequence.

options.title: Define structured output first
options.body: Create the compact diagnosis object before changing prose, then render the final user-facing panel from that object.

recommendation.title: Compose a final doctor verdict
recommendation.body: Add a final healthy/degraded/down diagnosis with probable causes and ordered next steps after the existing panels run.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal is repeated work on doctor orchestration and gateway service recovery paths.
